### Wisdom from the Psalms 8/30
Author: Wisdom from the Psalms
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-8-or-30-552540.html
Passage: Psalm 108:13
Points:
- Daunting personal challenges can feel completely overwhelming when faced in our own strength.
- The transforming power of Jesus Christ enables believers to overcome deep shyness and fear.
- Relying on God allows ordinary people to do valiant things they never thought possible.
- The Lord provides the victory to overcome internal enemies of the heart and mind.

### Read the Bible: Deuteronomy 21, Psalms 108-109, Isaiah 48, Revelation 18
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/deut-21-psalms-108-109-isaiah-48-revelation-18/
Passage: Psalm 108:1-13
Points:
- Psalm 108 combines sections of earlier psalms into a new song brimming with praise and confidence.
- The psalm serves to anchor and renew faith when preparing to embark on new ventures.
- God communicates His truth through varied life circumstances rather than detached abstract principles.
- The rich diversity and ultimate unity of the Scriptures prompt believers to exalt God over all creation.
